phase.reason: A current assignment-bound evaluation receipt exposed a second aggregate acceptance false-pass path: useful_output_gate is computed but not enforced by hard_pass/evaluate exit. Phase 1 must remain fail-closed until duplicate/conflict and usefulness aggregate controls are both durably proven.

actual_execution_authority.assignment_reason: The existing 14-role specialization remains non-conflicting and on the Phase-1 critical path; changing roles now would add control churn without reducing expected time to root.

evaluation_useful_output_false_pass_risk.observation: The evaluation role reconstructed the persisted six-record duplicate-effect trace and statically identified that useful_output_gate can be computed without controlling hard_pass/evaluate exit once coverage reaches 20.

evaluation_concurrency.classification: safe concurrency stop, not worker failure

changes_this_run.reason: Make useful-output adequacy a root-level hard acceptance/exit condition in addition to duplicate/conflict/false-completion/authority gates, without changing the active worker allocation.

critical_path: Evaluation must author checker-v2 without executing, durably precommit/read back expected controls bound to checker identity, then persist/read back checker-v2 before execution.
The unchanged duplicate-effect negative control must fail.
A >=20-opportunity useful-output negative control with useful_output_rate < 0.80 must fail even when all other hard gates pass.
A matched >=20-opportunity positive control with useful_output_rate >= 0.80 may pass only when every aggregate hard requirement holds.
Evidence comparator continues independent aggregate grading under current config12; optimizer independently rederives all aggregate controls before root closure.
Continue neuroscience own current Phase-1 probe, novelty config15 exact-fetch binding, and primary/human current-or-equivalent proof validation.

acceptance_progress.aggregate_gate_status: duplicate/conflict gate unresolved and useful-output hard gate newly required

rollback.condition: Rollback O_CHAT control6 only if the useful-output hard gate is shown to reject an independently adequate >=20-opportunity trace solely because of schema/transport error. Never weaken duplicate/conflict/authority gates or alter scheduler/O boundaries.

termination.reason: Material acceptance-method repair applied; checker-v2 controls and multiple role proofs remain unresolved.
